cost.notes: Per-run wall_s is one worker process (OMP/MKL/OpenBLAS threads 1), so its sum is the CPU proxy. D runs longer on average because it survives longer, so s_per_step and s_per_combat_decision are the length-adjusted cost. The box is shared (48 CPUs, 30 procs per arm); load at P's start includes D's own tail in the 5/15-min averages. Arms ran in sequence, not interleaved, so a load change between them confounds the time ratio.
